name: explore
description: Search and browse the Xquik X/Twitter API specification before making live API calls. Use it to find endpoint paths, parameters, response shapes, categories, and access requirements.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function that filters spec.endpoints and returns matching endpoint metadata.

name: xquik
description: Execute authenticated Xquik API requests for X/Twitter search, account lookup, posting, media, monitoring, draws, webhooks, compose, trends, and extraction workflows. Call explore first when endpoint details are unknown.

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function using xquik.request(path, { method, query, body }) to call Xquik REST endpoints.
